name: Braindecode

summary.en: Window/check EEG, or explicitly train a bounded sleep-stage classifier on subject-disjoint data.
summary.zh: 对脑电切窗检查，或明确选择睡眠分期模型，在按受试者隔离的数据上训练和预测。

input_description: Default preprocess: inputs.eeg JSON (sfreq_hz, unit uV/V, records with id/split/signals), <=32768 values; normalization=none preserves amplitude. Explicit sleep_fit: inputs.train/validation NPZ and schedule JSON, fixed Chambon2018 single-channel 100Hz/30s/5-stage model. sleep_predict: unlabelled data NPZ plus saved model JSON, development subjects rejected. See examples/braindecode-sleep. Do not apply a sleep model to unrelated EEG tasks or replace a study's preprocessing silently.

25.en: Preprocess: first-window preview. Sleep fit: data/shape check without training; predict: one-batch preview.
25.zh: 预处理时预览首个窗口；分期训练时仅检查输入和模型形状；预测时预览一个批次。

75.en: Preprocess: all windows. Explicit sleep fit: supervised training and validation checkpoint selection; predict: all supplied held-out epochs.
75.zh: 预处理时完成全部切窗；明确选择分期模式时完成训练、验证集选模型或全量留出预测。

100.en: Same preprocessing/training as 75 plus signal or validation QC; inference still uses only the fixed fitted model.
100.zh: 在 75 档相同处理或训练方法上增加信号或验证集质量检查；预测仍使用已固定的模型。

limitations: Levels control scope, not normalization strength. Default none preserves amplitude in uV. Explicit exponential_moving removes absolute amplitude and restarts at every chunk; validate it against the original method before adoption.
The adapter does not fit train-fold z-scores or apply band-pass filtering. Do not infer preprocessing suitability from the bio category alone.
The preprocessing mode does not train a classifier. The separate sleep modes use a fixed Chambon2018 baseline, not a current-SOTA claim, and never download pretrained weights.

Sleep training is limited to 12000 epochs per split and 5000 optimizer steps. Test labels, validation-only temperature fitting and scientific endpoint comparisons remain downstream. No temporal context or automatic model search is added.
Split labels are retained and records are normalized independently. Subject overlap or duplicate-record leakage requires a separate study-level check.
The bundled signal is synthetic and verifies integration only. Real EEG must be provided locally.

name: DeepXDE

summary.en: Solve a bounded oscillator or decay subproblem with a CPU PINN and independent residual checks.
summary.zh: 用 CPU 上的 PINN 求解小规模振子或衰减方程，并独立检查残差。

input_description: inputs.problem: JSON with equation (harmonic_oscillator/exponential_decay), duration and explicit equation parameters. params sets bounded CPU iterations, collocation points and network size; no equation code is evaluated.

25.en: Check the analytic reference against the equation with DeepXDE autodiff.
25.zh: 用自动微分核对解析参考解是否满足方程。

75.en: Train the PINN on the supplied bounded ODE and report reference error.
75.zh: 训练 PINN 求解指定方程，输出解和参考误差。

100.en: Solve and independently check held-out residuals and initial conditions.
100.zh: 完成求解，并在独立点上检查方程残差和初值误差。

limitations: Only harmonic-oscillator and exponential-decay ODE families are supported by this first adapter. Other PDEs require a dedicated validated adapter.
Training runs on PyTorch CPU with an explicit seed and bounded iterations. A completed run does not guarantee convergence.
The bundled analytic problem is an integration check, not evidence of improvement on existing research papers.

name: OpenMM

summary.en: Run a small CPU reference simulation from explicit molecular parameters or a prepared local PDB.
summary.zh: 根据显式分子参数或准备好的本地 PDB，运行小规模 CPU 参考模拟。

license: MIT for the API and Reference platform; accelerator plugins have separate LGPL terms
input_description: inputs.system: JSON masses_dalton, positions_nm, velocities_nm_ps (optional), bonds [[i,j,length_nm,k_kj_mol_nm2]]; or inputs.pdb: local prepared PDB compatible with bundled Amber14/TIP3P. 2–256 particles, Reference CPU, Verlet integration, no downloads.

25.en: Evaluate the starting energy and forces without running a trajectory.
25.zh: 先检查初始结构的能量与受力，不推进轨迹。

75.en: Produce the requested bounded reference trajectory.
75.zh: 生成指定时长内的参考模拟轨迹。

100.en: Produce the trajectory and check energy, momentum and half-step consistency.
100.zh: 完成参考模拟，并检查能量、动量和步长减半的一致性。

limitations: The explicit JSON format includes harmonic bonds only. A prepared PDB uses bundled Amber14/TIP3P, NoCutoff and no constraints; molecule preparation and parameterization validation remain the researcher's task.
The Reference CPU adapter uses Verlet (NVE). Initial temperature sets velocities and is not a thermostat. Matching an existing Langevin study requires a separate integrator extension.
The bundled harmonic molecule is synthetic. It checks execution and conservation, not the quality of a learned molecular propagator.
